requirement:
When authoring evidence for a named example, its complete fenced declaration
MUST be included in the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`.
rationale:
The subject has one obligation: when authoring evidence for a named example, include its complete fenced declaration in the mandatory input set.

**Implementation:** `src/authoring/inputs.rs#impl[AssessmentSources]/fn[prepare]` accepts example subjects and unconditionally starts the input selectors with the subject's full name. It resolves that selector through `src/authoring/inputs.rs#fn[source_input]`. The reachable `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[resolve]` includes matching examples and takes their declaration `raw_lines`; `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[to_input]` and `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[to_model_input]` include that text in the model input. `prepare` stores the resulting input in `mandatory`. This applies the mandatory-input contribution required by `requirements.examples.authoring_inputs`; the broader assembly and delivery obligations of `requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs` are context rather than independently reassessed here.

**Test:** `src/authoring/inputs.rs#mod[tests]/fn[bundle_combines_direct_references_terms_and_current_existing_selectors]` carries the subject's test reference, prepares evidence for `requirements.case`, verifies its example subject kind and mandatory-input selection, and asserts the complete declaration text, including the opening example fence, body with references, and closing fence.

No missing implementation, required test, or unacknowledged gap was found for this obligation.
